"""Refuter check 1: reproduce the minute headline numbers from the study's output files and profile the per-trade gain."""
import os, sys, json
os.environ["NUMBA_CACHE_DIR"] = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
OUT = "/home/user/money-maker/research/strategy_lab/fz_v3/out"
ST = os.path.join(OUT, "studies", "exit_policy")
sys.path.insert(0, OUT)
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import harness as H

tf = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "minute"
G = np.load(os.path.join(ST, f"c_grid_{tf}.npz")); V = json.load(open(os.path.join(ST, "c_variants.json")))
P = np.load(os.path.join(ST, f"c_pick_{tf}.npz")); C = np.load(os.path.join(ST, f"controls_{tf}.npz"))
lots = G["lots"]; NP = G["net_pos"]; N = NP / lots; fnd = G["fnd_net"]; entry = G["entry"]
T = H.load(tf); is_idx = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
assert np.array_equal(T.setup_i[is_idx], entry) and np.allclose(T.net[is_idx], fnd)
n = len(fnd)
print(f"{tf}: n={n}, Foundation mean {fnd.mean():.2f}")
means = N.mean(axis=0); best = int(np.argmax(means))
print("best IS variant", best, V[best]["keys"], f"mean {means[best]:.2f} diff {means[best]-fnd.mean():.2f}; above Foundation: {(means > fnd.mean()).sum()}")
v1176 = next(i for i, v in enumerate(V) if v["keys"] == dict(stop="foundation", scale="none", trail="none", time_stop=None, choch=False))
vch = next(i for i, v in enumerate(V) if v["keys"] == dict(stop="foundation", scale="none", trail="none", time_stop=None, choch=True))
print(f"variant foundation/none/none/None/False = {v1176}: mean {means[v1176]:.2f}; ...choch=True = {vch}: mean {means[vch]:.2f} (L1 label {fnd.mean():.2f}); trades where choch-on variant != L1 net: {(np.abs(N[:, vch]-fnd) > 0.005).sum()}")
st9 = next(i for i, v in enumerate(V) if v["keys"] == dict(stop=50, scale="L12", trail="3_1", time_stop=None, choch=False))
print(f"ST9: per position {NP[:, st9].mean():.2f}, per lot {N[:, st9].mean():.2f}, lots {lots[st9]}")
rc = C["rc_means"]
pct = lambda v: 100 * ((rc < v).sum() + 0.5 * (rc == v).sum()) / len(rc)
print(f"random control: mean {rc.mean():.2f} p5 {np.quantile(rc,.05):.2f} p95 {np.quantile(rc,.95):.2f}; Foundation pct {pct(fnd.mean()):.1f}; nested pct {pct(P['nested_net'].mean()):.1f}")
print(f"oracle free {C['oracle_free_net'].mean():.2f}, oracle floor {C['oracle_floor_net'].mean():.2f}")
# nested CV reproduced
local = np.full(T.n, -1); local[is_idx] = np.arange(n)
oof = np.full(n, np.nan); picks = []
for b, (tr, te) in enumerate(H.purged_splits(T)):
    trl, tel = local[tr], local[te]
    pick = int(np.argmax(N[trl].mean(axis=0))); picks.append(pick); oof[tel] = N[tel, pick]
print("nested picks", picks)
print(f"nested OOF mean {oof.mean():.2f} diff {(oof-fnd).mean():.2f}; file nested_net mean {P['nested_net'].mean():.2f}; identical: {np.allclose(oof, P['nested_net'])}")
# CPCV reproduced
oof_by = {}
for tr, te, (a, b) in H.cpcv_splits(T):
    trl, tel = local[tr], local[te]; pick = int(np.argmax(N[trl].mean(axis=0))); oof_by[(a, b)] = N[tel, pick]
paths = H.cpcv_paths(T, oof_by)
dd = np.array([(p[is_idx] - fnd).mean() for p in paths])
print("CPCV diffs", np.round(dd, 2), f"median {np.median(dd):.2f} p5 {np.quantile(dd,.05):.2f} min {dd.min():.2f}")
# the per-trade gain of the nested pick
d = P["nested_net"] - fnd
top = np.quantile(d, 0.99)
print("\n--- per-trade gain d = nested - Foundation")
print(f"mean {d.mean():.2f} median {np.median(d):.2f}; d>0: {(d>0).sum()} ({(d>0).mean():.1%}), d<0: {(d<0).sum()} ({(d<0).mean():.1%}), d==0: {(d==0).sum()} ({(d==0).mean():.1%})")
print(f"among nonzero: share positive {(d[d!=0]>0).mean():.1%}, mean gain when >0 {d[d>0].mean():.0f}, mean loss when <0 {d[d<0].mean():.0f}")
print(f"top1% gains removed (study metric): {d[d < top].mean():.2f}  (removed {(d>=top).sum()} trades, their sum {d[d>=top].sum():.0f} vs total sum {d.sum():.0f})")
print(f"top1% winners removed (harness GO metric): {d[P['nested_net'] < np.quantile(P['nested_net'], 0.99)].mean():.2f}")
lo, hi = np.quantile(d, [0.01, 0.99])
print(f"symmetric 1%/1% trim: {d[(d > lo) & (d < hi)].mean():.2f}; 5%/5% trim: {d[(d > np.quantile(d,.05)) & (d < np.quantile(d,.95))].mean():.2f}")
print(f"top 2% gains removed {d[d < np.quantile(d,.98)].mean():.2f}; top 0.5% gains removed {d[d < np.quantile(d,.995)].mean():.2f}")
# what does the top-1%-gains-removed metric give for a *pure random* exit policy vs itself? sanity: a policy identical to Foundation gives 0.
# How does the same metric treat the sign-flipped policy (Foundation - nested)? symmetric check
d2 = -d; print(f"the metric applied to Foundation-vs-nested (sign flipped): {d2[d2 < np.quantile(d2,.99)].mean():.2f}")
# sign blocks & by year
blk = T.block[is_idx]
bm = np.array([d[blk == b].mean() for b in range(12)]); print("block means of d", np.round(bm, 1), f"positive {int((bm>0).sum())}/12")
yr = pd.Series(T.day[is_idx]).str.slice(0, 4).to_numpy()
for y in sorted(set(yr)): m = yr == y; print(f"  {y}: n {m.sum()} mean d {d[m].mean():.1f}  top1%-removed {d[m][d[m] < np.quantile(d[m], .99)].mean():.1f}  share d>0 {(d[m]>0).mean():.2f}")
# the reason mix of the nested policy vs L1
print("\nL1 reason mix:", pd.Series(T.F.l1_exit_reason.to_numpy()[is_idx]).value_counts().to_dict())

# 7. PBO reproduced

print("effective trials (kept_sum):", H.effective_trials(vecs))

content.subject: Install the program's Python packages (shap, hmmlearn, mapie, arch, torch, psutil) and verify imports
content.description: numpy pandas pyarrow scipy scikit-learn xgboost shap numba matplotlib joblib torch statsmodels hmmlearn mapie ruptures arch stumpy; verify every import; note versions (pandas 3.x vs local 2.3.3) in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md

content.subject: Rebuild both datasets (1m, 5m) from fz_v3/data via engine.load; cross-check against fz_v3/built; write QUALITY.md
content.description: One build script per timeframe under fz_v3/out/build/: engine.run (ST1 rules on 1m, ST2 on 5m), Foundation trades priced (lot 65, 5 pts slip, ZERODHA_NFO_FUT), fz.run with ST7/ST8 blocks, per-SETUP feature table with the same column contract as built/, plus the L1 intraday 15:25 label, the truncation causality check. Compare SETUP counts, trades, room card against fz_v3/built; the cloud rebuild wins; log discrepancies in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md.

content.subject: Validation harness: splitter (12 IS blocks, purge by label exit, 3-session embargo), CPCV paths, append-only ledger via score(), PBO, DSR, block bootstrap, SPA
content.description: fz_v3/out/harness.py: the single evaluator. Every gate candidate goes through score(); kept-vs-skipped expectancy, session-matched random control (fz_report.random_control), permutation p (fz_report.permutation_p), CPCV 11 paths, go/no-go rule (PBO <= 0.2, CPCV p5 diff > 0, DSR p < 0.1, kept share >= 20%, kept n >= 300/80, top-1%-removed value > 0, slippage 8 pts survival). Break tests (BDE CUSUM, Chow) as pre-registration.

content.subject: Feature vocabulary pass: clustered MDA/MDI/SFI, FFD, BSADF/CUSUM, BOCPD run length, novelty scalars, SHAP interactions; freeze <= 8 clusters
content.description: quant-ml-canon-feature-importance merged with the feature contributions of regime-breaks, regime-states (BOCPD, GMM), motif (nn_dist_prefix, p1_dist_prefix), rocket window summaries. Per-year stability filter. Shortlist frozen in the ledger before any gate search.

content.subject: H1-H5 classical studies through the harness (gate audit, regime, volume, levels, learned gate) on IS
content.description: H1 what ST7/ST8 skip (precision/recall as loser filter, big winners); H2 regime grid; H3 visibly-high-volume reaction; H4 level respect vs break; H5 depth-3 tree + greedy rule list + GBM ceiling. All IS, via score(), every trial in the ledger.

content.subject: Learned-gate family: meta-labelling + full-information policy tree, distilled to rule list / scorecard; regime states; LLM hypotheses (round 0 blind, round 1 cross-fitted); FQI exit; session stop; conformal operating point; sizing
content.description: DESIGN_PANEL merged program: meta-label gate (L1 label, winsorised |net| weights, HGB/bagging ceilings, scorecard, rule list), policy trees, GMM/HMM/BOCPD regime states, LLM-hypothesis rounds with family-wise max-T permutation, FQI exit policy (learner C grid, B hindsight imitation, A FQI), session stop rule with within-session x hour null, conformal skip operating point, sizing conditional on a surviving gate, null tapes (5m), adversarial drift.
content.activeForm: Running the learned-gate family and modern-ML studies

content.subject: Walk-forward learn-after-each-trade policy with the trade journal (IS learning curve, continued through OOS); compose with rl.py for exit/size
content.description: fz_learn.py prototype: journal rows per SETUP (features, decision, reason, model state id, fill, exit, MFE/MAE, pts, gross, costs, net, R, running equity/DD/PF); online learners (LinUCB/Thompson on logistic or tree-embedded model, online GBM refits, k-trade cadence); fractional Kelly sizing with max lots and daily loss stop; learning curve vs take-all and random control; deterministic replay.

content.subject: OOS opened once by one script for at most three frozen candidates (rule list, learner, ST7/ST8 comparator)
content.description: fz_v3/out/oos_once.py reads frozen candidate JSON + sha; scores OOS 2026-01-01..2026-09-25 with random control, permutation p, kept-vs-skipped, winner recall; the learner continues updating through OOS as it would live. Caveats: OOS window = published lab window, used by ST9-12 exit grid.

content.subject: Report survivors and plan to the user before creating strategy files; then code ST13/ST14 (fz_learn.py, strategy_13/14.json, tests, docs, S49, REPORT.md)
content.description: Tell the user the plan and survivors first. Then: fz_learn.py beside fz.py (entry_rule fz_v3), strategy_13.json / strategy_14.json with every threshold / weight / hyper-parameter as a sourced key, journal as an output table, deterministic replay, engine.py untouched, ST5-ST8 bit-for-bit unchanged; extend tests/test_fz_parity.py and tests/test_truncation.py; FZ.md, README.md, S49 (Rule 0), fz_v3/out/REPORT.md, QUALITY.md.

content.subject: Commit and push on research/strategy-lab-pwxiug (code, strategy files, tests, docs, fz_v3/out only); open draft PR
content.description: Never commit results/, cache/, web/. Push with -u; create a draft PR if none exists.

content.subject: rocket_ceiling: benchmark, write rocket_ceiling.py, run under nohup, write FINDINGS.md + findings.json
content.description: Study rocket_ceiling under OUT/studies/rocket_ceiling: window tensor (L=60, 7 channels), 2,000 MiniRocket-style kernels, fold-fitted biases, L2 logistic probe with nested GroupKFold alpha, comparators (tabular HGB, PCA-16 window probe, stacked HGB), 12 purged splits + 66 CPCV splits -> 11 paths, AUC gain distribution, pre-registered stop at CPCV p5 gain < 0.03, gates at skip 30/50/70% as ledger rows (rocket/<model>), truncation check of the window tensor, timing + RSS, FINDINGS.md and findings.json.

issues.what: The family SPA p-values reported as the multiplicity verdict are inflated by an implementation artifact: harness.spa studentises every candidate, and variant 1177 (foundation stop + exit_on_choch_against, which equals the L1 benchmark on all but 8 of 4,452 minute trades / 1 of 826 five-minute trades; per-session gain sd 6.5 INR on minute, 40 INR on 5m) produces a heavy-tailed bootstrap statistic that attains the family max in 302/2000 RC and 396/2000 SPA draws on minute and 755/2000 on 5-minute (its statistic exceeds 17,000 in 37% of 5m draws). issues.evidence: Reproduced with the study's own vectors and bootstrap indices (tag 'exit|<tf>'): as run RC p 0.5010 / SPA p 0.3960 (minute), 0.5175 / 0.4965 (5m). Variant 1177 minute: real-difference sessions 7, sd 6.484, bootstrap statistic p90 2.08, p99 4.57, share >= rc_stat 0.134 vs 0.043 for a N(0,1) candidate. The pre-registered version, computed by the study itself as diff_top1_winners_removed, is +4.01 (pass) but is omitted from FINDINGS.md's table and from the pass rule. 06_findings.py's docstring states the pass rule was written after learner C's results were read. The 'no candidate' verdict is unaffected because SPA fails regardless (and under the harness GO the book also fails kept_mean_slip8 > 0 at -1313 and DSR p 1.0), but the FINDINGS attribute the failure to a post-hoc metric.

issues.evidence: Reproduced from c_pick_minute.npz / c_grid_minute.npz: d = nested - Foundation, mean 86.57; top 45 trades (1%) sum 682,848 vs total 385,417; d[d < q99].mean() = -67.49 (matches); d[net < q99(net)].mean() = +4.01 (matches eval_minute.json diff_top1_winners_removed); symmetric 1% trim +7.46; sign-flipped series under the same metric -162.33. d > 0 on 37.6% of trades (mean +1,756), d < 0 on 62.4% (mean -921); 2022 alone is -62/trade over 1,087 trades.

issues.what: Learner B's inner 3-fold for p* uses interleaved inner test blocks (tr_blocks[i::3]) with a purge over the min..max bar range of those blocks, which removes every block lying between them: the inner training sets are a single block (250-492 trades on minute, 47-82 on 5-minute) instead of ~5 blocks. issues.what: The random-exit control cannot discriminate any stop-based policy from the benchmark: the Foundation L1 exit itself scores 97.0 (>= 95) on minute and 96.8 on 5-minute against a no-stop uniform-bar exit, so the pass-rule check 'random_pct >= 95' is vacuous for a policy-vs-Foundation comparison. issues.evidence: controls_minute.npz: Foundation pct 97.0, nested 100.0; ST9 (diff -1.1) also 97.0; 5m Foundation 96.8.

issues.fix: Either register a summary trial count for this family in the harness ledger or have the program-level DSR/SPA scripts read exit_ledger.jsonl too; state the trial count in REPORT.md.
